'''Paqualis III''', also known as '''Paqualis''', was an urbanized [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Paqualis system/Legends|Paqualis system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Corvastan Benelex]] of [[House Benelex]]. It was the headquarters of the [[House Benelex|Benelex Bounty Hunters Guild]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Paqualis remained loyal to the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

Paqualis III was the site of a [[Battle of Paqualis|battle]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. The New Republic was defeated but the Paqualis system was not integrated to [[Zsinj's Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paqualis III is incorrectly spelled Paquallis III in ''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]''.
